stock.description: Chi Ho Development Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding entity primarily focused on providing a range of construction and property-related services in Hong Kong. The company's core offerings include comprehensive renovation and maintenance, covering general upkeep, restoration, and enhancement of existing building structures, their internal systems, and surrounding areas. It also specializes in structural alterations, modifications to building layouts, and detailed interior finishing for current premises. Additionally, the firm conducts ground preparation and specialized geotechnical engineering projects. Beyond these primary construction activities, Chi Ho Development Holdings diversifies its operations through the sale of floodlights, as well as property acquisition for investment and rental purposes. Founded in 1999, the company's principal office is located in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
